section: Satavahana art and architecture - Amaravati and Nagarjunakonda, rock-cut caves (Karle, Bhaja, Nasik)

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding ivory craftsmanship in the Satavahana period is correct?
o: Ivory guilds donated at Amaravati, and ivory carvers of Vidisha carved the Sanchi gateway.
Ivory guilds donated at Sanchi, and ivory carvers of Amaravati carved the Vidisha gateway.
Ivory guilds were associated only with royal workshops at Amaravati.
The Sanchi gateway was carved by sculptors from Nagarjunakonda.
accepted.x: Guilds of ivory workers made donations at Amaravati. The ivory carvers of Vidisha are associated with the carving of the Sanchi gateway.
accepted.tq: Match the craft centre with the correct artistic contribution.

accepted.s: Kondapur, an important archaeological site in Telangana, is associated with the discovery of:
o: Bronze and marble Buddhas in Amaravati style only
Only stone tools and megalithic burials
accepted.x: Kondapur yielded terracotta figurines, beads and coins. The other combinations refer to different sites or unsupported associations.
accepted.tq: Use direct site–find association and reject objects belonging to neighbouring sites.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Nelakondapalli:
1. It has a post-Satavahana mahastupa.
2. Bronze and marble Buddhas in the Amaravati style have been found there.
3. A sculptor’s workshop associated with V. V. Krishna Sastry has been identified there.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Nelakondapalli is associated with a post-Satavahana mahastupa, bronze and marble Buddhas in the Amaravati style, and a sculptor’s workshop identified with V. V. Krishna Sastry.
accepted.tq: Test a cluster of site-specific archaeological facts; the all-inclusive option is correct.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the Buddhist International Tourism Circuit listed for Andhra Pradesh?
o: Amaravati, Thotlakonda-Bavikonda, Bojjannakonda-Sankaram, Salihundam and Ghantasala
Amaravati, Kondapur, Nelakondapalli, Sanchi and Sarnath
Nagarjunakonda, Karle, Bhaja, Nasik and Ratnagiri
Amaravati, Ellora, Ajanta, Guntupalli and Palitana
accepted.x: The circuit comprises Amaravati, Thotlakonda-Bavikonda, Bojjannakonda-Sankaram, Salihundam and Ghantasala. It is intended to attract visitors from Japan, Korea, Sri Lanka, Thailand and Myanmar.
accepted.tq: Recall the complete named list without substituting nearby Buddhist sites.

accepted.s: The Buddhist International Tourism Circuit of Andhra Pradesh is particularly intended to attract visitors from which of the following groups of countries?
o: Japan, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore and Laos
Japan, Korea, Sri Lanka, Thailand and Myanmar
Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Afghanistan and Nepal
China, Nepal, Bhutan, Vietnam and Cambodia
accepted.x: The identified visitor markets are Japan, Korea, Sri Lanka, Thailand and Myanmar.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between closely related Asian country groups in a tourism-policy question.

accepted.s: Buddhavanam theme park is located at:
accepted.x: Buddhavanam is a 279-acre Buddhist theme park at Nagarjuna Sagar in Nalgonda, Telangana.
accepted.tq: Apply the location trap by distinguishing Buddhavanam from Buddhist sites in Andhra Pradesh.

accepted.s:
With reference to Buddhavanam, consider the following statements:
1. It is spread over 279 acres.
2. It hosted contestants of Miss World 2025.
3. It is situated at Nagarjuna Sagar in Nalgonda district.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Buddhavanam is a 279-acre theme park at Nagarjuna Sagar in Nalgonda, Telangana, and it hosted Miss World 2025 contestants.
accepted.tq: Combine numerical, event and location clues to identify the complete correct set.

accepted.s: The chaitya and vihara forms developed during the Satavahana period are significant because they:
o: Replaced all structural temples during the Gupta period
Became the base for later Hindu temple architecture
Were used exclusively for Jain religious architecture
Originated only after the construction of the Sanchi gateway
accepted.x: Satavahana chaitya-vihara forms became the base for later Hindu temple architecture. They were not exclusive to Jain architecture and did not replace all structural temples.
accepted.tq: Infer the architectural consequence from the stated continuity between Buddhist and Hindu forms.

accepted.s: Who built the earliest structural Hindu temples referred to in the context of the transition from chaitya-vihara architecture?
accepted.x: The Ikshvakus built the earliest structural Hindu temples, while Satavahana chaitya-vihara forms provided an architectural base for later Hindu temple architecture.
accepted.tq: Use the builder–achievement association and avoid swapping neighbouring dynasties.

accepted.s: The only rock-cut Buddhist cave temple in Andhra Pradesh is identified with:
accepted.x: Guntupalli is identified as the only rock-cut Buddhist cave temple in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Use the FIRST/LAST or ONLY clue to distinguish unique sites.

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about the present cultural and political significance of Amaravati is correct?
1. Amaravati was a Satavahana capital.
2. Amaravati is associated with the Mahachaitya.
3. Amaravati is the modern capital of Andhra Pradesh.
4. Amaravati is listed among India’s three major ancient art schools.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Amaravati is described as a Satavahana capital, the site of the Mahachaitya, the modern capital of Andhra Pradesh, and one of India’s three major ancient art schools.
accepted.tq: Check every item in a multi-dimensional place profile before selecting the inclusive code.

accepted.s: The Buddha is traditionally believed to have taught the Kalachakra at Amaravati, which is also known by the ancient name:
accepted.x: Amaravati is identified with ancient Dhanyakataka, where the Buddha is believed to have taught the Kalachakra.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between ancient place names associated with major Buddhist centres.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following developments in chronological order:
A. Sarnath becomes India’s 45th World Heritage Site
B. Andhra Pradesh is named Best Tourism Promotion State at the GTM awards
C. The Buddhist International Tourism Circuit is listed in the AP Socio-Economic Survey
D. The Discover Andhra Buddhist-circuit campaign is launched
accepted.x: The order is the listing in the AP Socio-Economic Survey 2025–26, the February 2026 Discover Andhra campaign, the May 2026 GTM award, and Sarnath’s designation on 27 July 2026.
accepted.tq: Arrange events by their stated years and months, using the earliest dated event first.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding the heritage status of Buddhist sites is correct?
o: Sarnath and Amaravati Stupa are both permanently inscribed as World Heritage Sites, whereas Odisha’s Buddhist sites have no heritage listing.
Amaravati Stupa is already India’s 45th World Heritage Site, while Sarnath is only on the tentative list.
Only Ratnagiri has been placed on the UNESCO tentative list, while Amaravati Stupa has been excluded from it.
Amaravati Stupa is on India’s UNESCO tentative list, while Ratnagiri-Udayagiri-Lalitagiri in Odisha have also been placed on the tentative list.
accepted.x: Amaravati Stupa is on India’s UNESCO tentative list, and Odisha’s Ratnagiri-Udayagiri-Lalitagiri have also been placed on the tentative list. Sarnath is identified separately as India’s 45th World Heritage Site.
accepted.tq: Separate tentative-list status from full World Heritage inscription.

accepted.s: The sea-trade text associated with the Reddi period is:
accepted.x: Haravilasam is the text associated with Reddi-period sea trade in this context. Kashikhandam is a different text and is not the required answer here.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the specifically associated literary work from a closely related textual distractor.

accepted.s: Which recent legislative development concerns Amaravati?
o: A Bill was cleared to transfer the sole capital of Andhra Pradesh from Amaravati to Nagarjunakonda.
A constitutional amendment declared Amaravati a Union Territory.
A Bill was cleared to make Amaravati the sole capital of Telangana.
A Bill was cleared to make Amaravati the sole capital of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.x: The Lok Sabha cleared a Bill making Amaravati the sole capital of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct authority–decision–place combination and reject State-swapping traps.
